collection.description: Two villagers offer to carry supplies for an older neighbor.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Two villagers offer to carry supplies for (name1), an older neighbor. The work finishes faster with so many hands.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two villagers offer to carry supplies for (name1), an older neighbor. Afterward, the group lingers just to enjoy being together.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Two villagers offer to carry supplies for (name1), an older neighbor. The help is appreciated, even though nobody makes a speech.
